opportunities.title: Main Grants Fund

amount.raw: Up to £500,000, in special cases up to £750,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Research relevant to one or more of the priority questions outlined in the Strategic Review. Proposals must meet criteria such as relevance, impact, conceptual framework, rigour, experience, and value for money. Applicants must have a formal employment or contractual relationship with the institution hosting the grant.
opportunities.summary: Funding for research that addresses one or more of the priority questions outlined in the Strategic Review. Proposals must be relevant, impactful, and methodologically rigorous.

opportunities.title: Racial Diversity UK Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Research on racial diversity within the UK, particularly focusing on racial inequalities, discrimination, and pathways to racial justice. Proposals should contribute to understanding, public debate, policy, and practice on tackling racial inequalities.
opportunities.summary: Funding for research on racial diversity within the UK, focusing on racial inequalities, discrimination, and pathways to racial justice.
